record.question: The drug which can be used to numb pain sensation during minor operation like wound stitching is:
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Lignocaine. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 10, printed Q32. Source limitation: Both lignocaine and bupivacaine are local anesthetics that can be used for minor procedures; no duration requirement is given. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
